mechanistic_correction: The frozen PlaylistMutation.deduplicated implementation returns uniqueResult(items) for a singleton before reading item.id. In invalid-source-unicode-1, the eager PR #140 baseline rejects the unsupported source authority before item normalization; the lazy candidate normalizes the Unicode item once before rejecting the source. Deduplication does not perform a second normalization in this singleton case. In the unsupported-item controls, delaying rejection can additionally scan unsupported items.
